data.title: Emergency Fungicide Application – Tomato Late Blight
data.description: AI scan confirmed active Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans) on 42% of your tomato beds. Conditions are ideal for rapid spread — high humidity 72% and night temps 22°C.
data.suggestedAction: Spray Mancozeb 75WP @ 2.5g/L + Cymoxanil 8% WP immediately. Remove and bury all infected leaves. Repeat spray every 7 days.
data.expectedBenefit: Halt disease progression within 5 days. Save 60–70% of remaining healthy crop. Prevent yield loss worth ₹4.2 lakh.

data.title: File Crop Insurance Claim Immediately
data.description: Farm 010 has sustained 58% crop damage from root rot and pink bollworm. Estimated revenue loss of ₹28 lakh. PMFBY claim window closes within 72 hours of damage notification.
data.suggestedAction: Collect drone evidence report, soil test results, and file PMFBY claim at your nearest CSC or bank before 2026-08-12. Keep all spray records.
data.expectedBenefit: Potential insurance payout of ₹18–22 lakh covering majority of crop loss.

data.title: Delay Grape Harvest – Market Timing Opportunity
data.description: Current mandi price ₹55/kg. Post-monsoon demand spike expected mid-September. Grapes at 18° Brix can be held 2–3 weeks in cold storage at -1°C with 90% humidity.
data.suggestedAction: Delay harvest by 18 days. Book cold storage space at Nashik Cold Chain Hub (₹8/kg/month). List on e-NAM for direct buyer access.
data.expectedBenefit: Price improvement from ₹55 to ₹72–80/kg. Additional revenue of ₹22–40 lakh on projected 382-tonne harvest.

data.title: Register on APEDA for Alphonso Export
data.description: Dubai and Singapore buyers actively seeking Alphonso mango at 40% premium. Your farm-008 produce meets Global GAP standards based on recent soil and disease reports.
data.suggestedAction: Register at apeda.gov.in/apedawebsite/subHead_Products/Mango.htm. Obtain phytosanitary certificate from nearest plant quarantine station.
data.expectedBenefit: Revenue jump from ₹150/kg domestic to ₹210/kg export price. Extra income ₹90 lakh on 150-tonne yield.

data.name: Apply Zinc Sulphate Before Wheat Sowing
data.description: Soil test (soil-002) reveals zinc deficiency in North Wheat Field. Zinc-deficient soil reduces tillering and grain filling in wheat, causing 15–20% yield loss if untreated.
data.suggestedAction: Broadcast zinc sulphate 21% @ 25kg/ha before last ploughing. Apply as basal dose mixed with DAP for uniform distribution.
data.expectedBenefit: Improve yield by 12–15% (additional 60–75 tonnes). Improve grain protein content. ROI 8x on input cost.

data.title: Enroll Sugarcane in Drip Micro-Irrigation Scheme
data.description: Current flood irrigation uses 1,800mm water/season. Drip can reduce to 900mm while increasing yield 20–25%. PMKSY-PDMC subsidy covers 55% of cost for SC/ST, 45% for others.
data.suggestedAction: Apply at nearest Agriculture Office for PMKSY-PDMC subsidy. Install Jain or Netafim subsurface drip for 140 acres. Combine with fertigation.
data.expectedBenefit: Save ₹85,000/season on water. Yield increase from 70 to 85 t/ha = ₹42 lakh extra revenue. Break-even in 2 seasons.

data.title: Switch Bajra Variety to MPMH-17 for Higher Yield
data.description: Your current HHB-67 yields ~1.5 t/ha. MPMH-17 hybrid trials in Rajasthan show 2.2–2.6 t/ha under similar conditions. Well-suited for Jodhpur's dryland sandy-loam soils.
data.suggestedAction: Source MPMH-17 seed from MPKV Rahuri or state seed corporation. Sow at 4 kg/ha in rows of 45cm x 15cm spacing for optimal tiller development.
data.expectedBenefit: Yield increase from 195 to 280–338 tonnes. Additional revenue ₹25–42 lakh depending on moisture conditions.

data.title: Apply Calcium Nitrate to Improve Apple Colour and Size
data.description: Soil-021 shows adequate macronutrients but low calcium availability. Calcium deficiency causes bitter pit disorder and poor fruit colouring in Royal Delicious apples.
data.suggestedAction: Foliar spray of Calcium Nitrate 1% (10g/L) at fruit set, 30 days later, and 15 days before harvest. 3 sprays total.
data.expectedBenefit: Reduce bitter pit incidence from 8% to <1%. Improve Grade-A fruit ratio from 65% to 85%. Extra income ₹12 lakh from quality premium.

data.title: Sell Turmeric Stock Now – 3-Year Price Peak
data.description: Erode mandi turmeric finger price at ₹4,200/qtl — highest since 2023. Seasonal analysis suggests prices may dip 15–20% post-September with new crop arrivals from Sangli and Nizamabad.
data.suggestedAction: List available stock on e-NAM platform immediately. Contact direct buyers in Erode, Salem markets. Consider partial sale and hold rest for Diwali demand.
data.expectedBenefit: Sell at ₹4,200 vs projected Oct price of ₹3,400–3,600. Save ₹6–8 lakh vs waiting for new crop season.

data.title: Rhizobium Seed Inoculation for Soybean
data.description: Soil test shows adequate NPK but no history of Rhizobium inoculation. Inoculation creates nitrogen-fixing root nodules that can supply 40–80 kg N/ha from atmosphere.
data.suggestedAction: Treat soybean seed with Bradyrhizobium japonicum culture (250g/30kg seed) + PSB. Apply in shade, sow within 24 hours. Avoid chemical seed treatment day.
data.expectedBenefit: Save ₹4,000–6,000/ha on nitrogen fertilizer. Improve yield 8–12%. Improve soil nitrogen for next wheat crop.

data.title: Install Weather Station for Precision Irrigation
data.description: Manual irrigation scheduling is causing 30% water waste. An automated weather station with soil moisture sensors can trigger drip irrigation at exact crop water requirements.
data.suggestedAction: Install IMD-approved agro-weather station (₹35,000–55,000). Integrate with AgriNova API for automated irrigation triggers. Apply for DST subsidy.
data.expectedBenefit: Save 35% irrigation water. Reduce pumping cost ₹22,000/season. Improve yield uniformity across fields by eliminating over/under-watering stress.

data.title: Preventive Blast Spray Before Panicle Emergence
data.description: Weather forecast shows 4–5 days of high humidity (88%+) and temperature 26–28°C — perfect conditions for rice blast. Your MTU-1010 variety is moderately susceptible.
data.suggestedAction: Spray Tricyclazole 75WP @ 0.6g/L at panicle initiation stage (PI). Follow with Propiconazole 25EC @ 1mL/L at 50% heading.
data.expectedBenefit: Prevent 20–30% yield loss from blast. Protect ₹15–23 lakh worth of paddy crop from current disease risk.

data.title: Enroll in PMFBY Before August 31 Deadline
data.description: Farm 015 has 52% active root rot damage and is at high risk for total crop failure. PMFBY insurance can compensate ₹35,000–40,000/hectare for notified disasters.
data.suggestedAction: Visit nearest bank or CSC before 31 Aug 2026. Carry land records, Aadhaar, and bank passbook. Premium is 2% of sum assured (govt subsidizes rest).
data.expectedBenefit: Insure 105 ha at ₹40,000/ha sum assured. Potential payout up to ₹42 lakh if crop fails, covering input costs and partial income.

data.title: Optimize Tea Plucking to Two-Leaf-and-Bud Standard
data.description: Drone analysis shows 15% coarse leaf in current flush. Consistent two-leaf-and-bud plucking increases made-tea quality by 1.5–2 grades, significantly boosting auction prices.
data.suggestedAction: Retrain pluckers using visual guides. Introduce plucking incentive at ₹2 extra/kg for clean pluck. Use round plucking shears for shade bushes.
data.expectedBenefit: Improve auction average from ₹180/kg to ₹210–225/kg. On 110-tonne season, extra revenue of ₹33–49 lakh.

data.title: Plan Wheat After Soybean for Nitrogen Benefit
data.description: Soybean-wheat rotation has been practised on this farm. Soybean leaves 40–60 kg residual N/ha in soil. Capitalize on this by reducing wheat N dose in next rabi season.
data.suggestedAction: After soybean harvest, incorporate crop residue. Reduce basal urea dose in wheat by 20kg/ha. Apply split N at tillering instead.
data.expectedBenefit: Save ₹8,000–10,000/ha on urea in wheat crop. Maintain yield parity. Improve soil organic carbon over 3-year cycle.

data.title: Partial Harvest Salvage and Soil Remediation Plan
data.description: 55% of farm-020 is critically affected. The remaining 45% healthy area (51.75 ha) has harvestable cotton. Soil in damaged areas needs full remediation before next season.
data.suggestedAction: 1) Harvest healthy 45% now (protect ₹27 lakh). 2) Deep plough diseased areas. 3) Apply FYM 5t/ha + Trichoderma 5kg/ha. 4) Sow green manure crop Dhaincha.
data.expectedBenefit: Recover ₹25–27 lakh from healthy crop. Restore diseased plots for normal productivity by Rabi 2026. Avoid total loss of ₹57 lakh.

data.title: Improve Drain Infrastructure to Prevent Waterlogging
data.description: Drone analysis detected waterlogging in south corner of farm-003 (11.7 ha affected). Recurring waterlogging reduces paddy yield by 25–30% and promotes sheath blight.
data.suggestedAction: Construct field drainage channel along south perimeter (80m x 0.5m x 0.6m). Install outlet to main drainage. Cost ~₹22,000. Apply under MGNREGA.
data.expectedBenefit: Prevent annual yield loss of 15–18 tonnes worth ₹3–3.6 lakh. One-time investment recovers in first season.

data.title: Whitefly Resistance Management – Insecticide Rotation
data.description: Whitefly on farm-022 has shown reduced sensitivity to imidacloprid (4th consecutive use). Resistance development can render chemical control ineffective within 2 seasons.
data.suggestedAction: Rotate to Spiromesifen 22.9SC this spray, then Buprofezin 25SC, then back to neonicotinoids. Install 12 yellow sticky traps/acre. Conserve parasitoid wasps.
data.expectedBenefit: Prevent complete resistance development. Maintain 85–90% whitefly control efficacy. Protect ₹60 lakh cotton crop from vector-borne virus diseases.

data.title: Apply Micronutrient Mix for Nagpur Orange Colour Development
data.description: Soil and leaf analysis indicate low zinc and boron levels in Citrus Grove C1. These micronutrients are critical for fruit colour, peel quality and export grade in Nagpur mandarin.
data.suggestedAction: Foliar spray of Zinc Sulphate 0.5% + Boric Acid 0.2% + Magnesium Sulphate 1% at marble-size fruit stage and 45 days before harvest.
data.expectedBenefit: Improve Export/Grade-A ratio from 60% to 78%. On 576-tonne crop, extra 104 tonnes in premium grade adds ₹18–22 lakh additional revenue.

data.title: Apply Emamectin Benzoate for Fall Armyworm Control
data.description: Fall armyworm sightings in Patna district. Early instar larvae in whorl are highly susceptible to chemical control. Delay increases cost 3–5x as larvae move to cob stage.
data.suggestedAction: Apply Emamectin Benzoate 5SG @ 0.4g/L into the whorl using directed spray. Follow with second spray if >5% plants show fresh whorl damage.
data.expectedBenefit: Prevent 20–35% yield loss from FAW. Protect 396-tonne maize crop worth ₹71 lakh. Cost-benefit ratio 1:18.

data.title: Control Brown Plant Hopper Before Crop Lodging
data.description: Drone scan (drone-018) detected BPH colonies in farm-018 paddy. BPH feeding causes 'hopperburn' — circular wilted patches that can collapse entire crop if untreated.
data.suggestedAction: Apply Buprofezin 25SC @ 1mL/L or Ethiprole + Imidacloprid 40% SC @ 0.75mL/L at base of plant. Drain field to shallow flood 3–5 cm before spraying.
data.expectedBenefit: Prevent yield loss of 30–40% from hopperburn. Protect 224-tonne crop worth ₹53 lakh. Early action saves 90% of crop at <₹8,000 spray cost.

data.title: Apply Boron Fertilizer for Sunflower Seed Set
data.description: Soil report (soil-009) flags suspected boron deficiency. Boron is critical for pollen viability and seed set in sunflower. Deficiency can cause 25–40% seed filling failure.
data.suggestedAction: Foliar spray of Borax 0.2% (2g/L) at bud initiation and 10 days later. Avoid application during flowering in afternoon heat.
data.expectedBenefit: Improve seed-set rate from estimated 68% to 90%+. Recover 20–30 tonnes of otherwise lost grain. Revenue gain ₹11–16.5 lakh.
